description: Standard results frozen from the BioTSR 1.0.0rc1 build, the last build before compatibility functionality was removed, recomputed by tests/integration/test_standard_references.py. Keys files are compared by SHA-256 on every platform; triplet files only on macOS arm64, where the floating-point geometry was produced. Four larger protein C-alpha cases (2AC0, 3EJ1, 6G9M, 7LF9 chain A) carry the keys-file hashes the release gates froze for the same candidate.
